new_threads.name: The unrecognized treasure map
new_threads.reason: The party is following a treasure map whose marked locations they don't recognize, and the treasure's whereabouts remain unknown.

new_threads.name: The Clurichen of the riverbanks
new_threads.reason: Reginald warned of a trickster creature that comes into town nightly and should be avoided; this danger stands on its own and is still open.

new_threads.name: The dragon near Brandonsford
new_threads.reason: A black dragon troubles the town and Eric the Reeve offers 1000 gold for its body; leads (George, Gill's sighting, the Sir Brandon legend) and rivals (Gill's sons) all bear on this one hunt, which is not yet done.

new_threads.name: Hiring Lady Hilda
new_threads.reason: Lady Hilda offered to join for money against the dragon, and Sir Phidipaldi said they would come back for her after talking to the Reeve (beat_10), so it serves the dragon hunt and is still pending.

new_threads.name: Bentley's missing shipment
new_threads.reason: Bentley's restock shipment is a week overdue and nothing has reached town in months; no one is known to have gone after it.

new_threads.name: Sir Phidipaldi's challenge to Eric the Reeve
new_threads.reason: Sir Phidipaldi slapped Eric and challenged him to a dawn duel, which Eric never accepted (beat_19); Bentley banned fighting and ejected Phidipaldi (beat_24), but the quarrel is unsettled.

new_threads.name: Drop Dead Ned's offer of hire
new_threads.reason: Ned offered himself and his killer wasp for 100 gold a week, and Dr. Uriah said he'd think about it, so the offer stands.

new_threads.name: Shamus the mule
new_threads.reason: Gill offered to sell Shamus for 100 gold, Dunk asked to trade work instead, and Dunk is still thinking it over.

new_threads.name: Warwick the smith and his mithril shirt
new_threads.reason: Warwick displays a superb mithril chain shirt he refuses to sell and is growing strangely paranoid, both open matters the party might act on.

new_threads.name: Quinn's vanishing ale
new_threads.reason: Quinn's stock disappears nightly and he suspects Bentley; Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help for 100 gold and planned a fake shipment, which is still to be carried out.

shared_subjects.subject: Gill's work wanted in trade for the mule: killing the dragon
shared_subjects.reason: It is the work Gill names as the possible price of the mule, so it belongs with that bargain.

shared_subjects.subject: Lady Hilda's offer to join the dragon hunt for pay
shared_subjects.reason: The child thread about hiring Hilda is about this very offer.

shared_subjects.subject: Sir Phidipaldi's feud with Eric the Reeve
shared_subjects.reason: The quarrel has its own thread, though it may strain the Reeve's bounty.

shared_subjects.subject: No shipments reaching town for months
shared_subjects.reason: The missing shipment thread is about the very supply failure that empties Warwick's shop and makes Quinn's fake shipment plausible.
